# Tide Pill

Components · Live demo & interactive props: `/tango#/tide-pill`

Real consumers: **0** (imports outside `src/tango/docs/` and tests).

The labelled tag for a Dreamcaller's tides and affiliations. Hovering or pressing a pill reveals the tide's description through the shared InfoCard.

## Props

| Prop | Type | Required | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` | yes | — | The tide/affiliation name. Resolve any UUID to the display name before passing it — the pill renders copy from a plain string, not caller markup, so TidePill is a leaf, not a container. |
| `description` | `string` | yes | — | The tide's description, revealed through the shared InfoCard on hover / press. Required: a TidePill always carries its description so the reveal can never be forgotten. Plain prose — resolve before display. |
| `tide` | `Tide` = `"ember" \| "valor" \| "vision" \| "wild" \| "shadow"` | no | `shadow` | Which of the five tides. Fixes the pill's icon and color. Default 'shadow'. |
| `size` | `TidePillSize` = `"sm" \| "md"` | no | `md` | Height/scale. Default 'md'. |
| `stageRef` | `RefObject<HTMLElement \| null>` | no | — | Screen root the reveal anchors + clamps against. Pass it for the material-continuity reveal (preferred); omit it and the card floats directly above the pill. |
| `onPress` | `(() => void)` | no | — | Fires on a tap / click that was not a deliberate hold-to-read. |

## Usage

### Anchored reveal

Pass `stageRef` (the screen root) and the tide's InfoCard reveal is anchored to the pill and clamped fully on-screen — the preferred, material-continuity path.

```tsx
import { TidePill } from "src/tango/components/hud/TidePill";

<TidePill
  tide="vision"
  label="Singular Storm"
  description="A tide of sudden, singular force."
  stageRef={screenRef}
  onPress={selectTide}
/>
```

### Standalone

Omit `stageRef` and the same InfoCard floats directly above the pill — for list contexts with no positioned stage.

```tsx
<TidePill tide="valor" label="Rising Sun" description="A tide that crests at dawn." />
```
